assertion: For each package of the release, in order: a publish rehearsal; a configured trusted publisher, required for `@muxui/react` only (for schema, catalog, and tooling the evidence states as a non-claim that their trusted publishers are not yet set up and tokenless publishing is unproved for them; the provenance of their token publish proves neither); and a registry read-back of the exact version, integrity, provenance, and `next` at the verified rc. `latest` is not claimed (the registry sets it on a first publish; Decision 0023), and recovery is prepared, not exercised. Simulated refusals, with no registry mutation: a version collision, an artifact-integrity mismatch, and an invalid promotion lineage (a dry-run candidate from another commit, workflow, or version) each stop the release before any publish. A partial-publication rehearsal fails a later package in the order after earlier packages published, by a refused publish or a failed registry read-back. It proves the recovery: only a version that published bad bytes is deprecated and fixed forward, a package that never published needs no deprecation, healthy published versions stay published and are not deprecated (Decision 0023 amendment 01), the tuple is verified again, and no record is rewritten. For each later release, the prior tuple stays installable and verifiable by exact version: nothing is unpublished and the prior release manifests are retained. The first portfolio release has no prior tuple. Restoring the prior tuple stays owed by P2 exit.
